item_changes.comment: Revision required. Exact line search and Armijo backtracking are alternative step-selection rules, not mutually necessary concepts. Remove RC-013 from co_requisite_item_ids; retain it as a recommended neighbour and revise the rationale/confidence accordingly.

Revision required. Armijo backtracking is independently teachable after RC-010 and does not require exact line search to be introduced alongside it. Remove RC-012 from co_requisite_item_ids; retain it as a recommended neighbour and revise the rationale/confidence accordingly.

Revision required. AdaGrad does not require RMSProp and Adam to be introduced in the same instructional unit. Remove RC-024 and RC-025 from co_requisite_item_ids; recommended_neighbours already captures the useful comparison.

Revision required. RMSProp does not require AdaGrad and Adam to be introduced in the same instructional unit. Remove RC-023 and RC-025 from co_requisite_item_ids; recommended_neighbours already captures the useful comparison.

Revision required. Adam does not require AdaGrad and RMSProp to be introduced in the same instructional unit. Remove RC-023 and RC-024 from co_requisite_item_ids; recommended_neighbours already captures the useful comparison.

Revision required. RC-002 is useful motivation for solving the Newton model but is not necessary to state or interpret the second-order Taylor model. Remove RC-002 from hard_dependencies; if the stationarity motivation is retained, classify RC-002 as explanatory and provide an explicit fallback, or keep it only as a recommended neighbour.

Revision required. The theorem explicitly assumes a positive-definite Hessian, but the listed external prerequisite covers only local Lipschitz regularity. Add RC-003 as a hard or explanatory dependency, or extend the symmetric-matrices-and-definiteness external prerequisite to support RC-028; then revise the rationale.

Revision required. The external concept combines inverse-Hessian approximations with line search even though line-search knowledge is represented by RC-012 and RC-013. Narrow/rename the external concept to inverse-Hessian approximations and add an appropriate explanatory or implementation dependency on a Contract line-search item (normally RC-013), with a fallback if explanatory.

concept_changes.comment: Revision required. Extend supports_item_ids to RC-028 unless RC-003 is made a sufficient dependency there; RC-028 also requires the learner to interpret a positive-definite Hessian.

Revision required. Line search is already represented inside the Contract by RC-012 and RC-013, so it must not be bundled into an external prerequisite. Replace this record with a narrowly scoped inverse-Hessian-approximation concept and represent line-search knowledge through an internal dependency.

revision_scope.overall_comment: Revision required for RC-012, RC-013, RC-023, RC-024, RC-025, RC-026, RC-028, and RC-030. Remove artificial co-requisites among alternative methods, weaken the unnecessary stationarity prerequisite for the Newton Taylor model, and repair the definiteness and line-search prerequisite boundaries. All remaining item fields and external prerequisite records are approved or not applicable.
